oneOf.description: Extract lines that start with a specific prefix. Input: string → Output: array. Example: Extract markdown bullet points starting with '- '.

prefix.description: The prefix to match at the start of lines (e.g., '- ' for markdown lists, 'ERROR:' for error lines)

type.description: Extracts lines that start with a specific prefix

oneOf.description: Extract lines matching a regular expression pattern. Input: string → Output: array. Example: Extract lines matching '^[0-9]+\.' for numbered lists.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to match lines (e.g., '^ERROR:', '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+:')

type.description: Extracts lines matching a regex pattern

oneOf.description: Extract text between two marker strings. Input: string → Output: string. Example: Extract content between '[START]' and '[END]' markers.

end.description: End marker string (content before this marker will be included)

start.description: Start marker string (content after this marker will be included)

oneOf.description: Extract all text after a marker string. Input: string → Output: string. Example: Extract content after 'Results:' header.

marker.description: Marker string to search for (returns all text after this marker)

type.description: Extracts all text after a marker

oneOf.description: Extract all text before a marker string. Input: string → Output: string. Example: Extract content before '---' separator.

marker.description: Marker string to search for (returns all text before this marker)

type.description: Extracts all text before a marker

oneOf.description: Simple string replacement (replaces all occurrences). Input: string or array → Output: same type. Example: Replace ' and ' with ', ' to change separators.

new.description: String to replace with (optional, defaults to empty string for removal)

oneOf.description: Regex-based replacement (supports capture groups). Input: string or array → Output: same type. Example: Replace '\s+' with ' ' to normalize whitespace.

replacement.description: Replacement string (optional, defaults to empty string for removal)

oneOf.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace. Input: string or array → Output: same type. Works on each element if input is array.
Remove specific prefix from text. Input: string or array → Output: same type. Example: Remove '- ' from markdown list items.

prefix.description: Prefix to remove from the beginning of strings (e.g., '- ', '• ', 'Item: ')

type.description: Removes a specific prefix from text

oneOf.description: Remove specific suffix from text. Input: string or array → Output: same type. Example: Remove '.txt' from filenames.

suffix.description: Suffix to remove from the end of strings (e.g., '.txt', '.log', ':')

type.description: Removes a specific suffix from text

oneOf.description: Trim whitespace from each array element. Input: array → Output: array. Use this after split operations to clean up items.

type.description: Trims whitespace from each array element

oneOf.description: Convert text to lowercase. Input: string or array → Output: same type. Useful for case-insensitive comparisons.
Convert text to uppercase. Input: string or array → Output: same type. Useful for normalization.
Split string by delimiter. Input: string → Output: array. Example: Split 'a,b,c' by ',' into ['a','b','c'].
Split string by newlines. Input: string → Output: array. Commonly used as first step to process multi-line output.
Remove empty strings from array. Input: array → Output: array. Use after split operations to clean up empty elements.
Remove duplicate strings from array. Input: array → Output: array. Preserves first occurrence order.
